name: Arbitr Group Limited
summary: Arbitr Group Limited develops content governance and AI trust platform that provides trust layer between AI systems and enterprise publishing or operational environments. The company's software offers AI Content Governance Platform, designed to reduce risks associated with AI-generated business content; AI models, designed for efficiency and domain-specific performance; AI agents, to automate business processes; and AI evaluation and risk management. It serves legal teams, marketing departments, global organizations managing multilingual content, enterprise ai programs, and compliance functions. The company was formerly known as Straker Limited and changed its name to Arbitr Group Limited in September 2026. Arbitr Group Limited was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Auckland, New Zealand.
